mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_deposit_account (account_no, owner_id, owner_type, required_amount) VALUES (#{accountNo}, #{ownerId}, #{ownerType}, #{requiredAmount})
mapper.select: SELECT account_no, owner_id, owner_type, required_amount, balance, frozen_amount, balance - frozen_amount AS available_amount, status FROM t_deposit_account ORDER BY updated_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_deposit_flow (flow_no, account_no, flow_type, amount, before_balance, after_balance, before_frozen_amount, after_frozen_amount, reference_no, remark) VALUES (CONCAT('DFLOW-', REPLACE(UUID(), '-', '')), #{accountNo}, #{flowType}, #{amount}, #{beforeBalance}, #{afterBalance}, #{beforeFrozenAmount}, #{afterFrozenAmount}, #{referenceNo}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT flow_no, account_no, flow_type, amount, before_balance, after_balance, before_frozen_amount, after_frozen_amount, reference_no, remark, created_at FROM t_deposit_flow WHERE account_no = #{accountNo} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
